Name: Elemental Animals
Author: bobdawei
Description:
Elemental Animals adds four new animal variants to Stardew Valley, each tied to the metals found in the mines. They'll lay eggs like normal chickens and ducks that can be incubated or turned into ore

[b]Animals[/b]
Four new animals can be raised in your coop, Copper Chicken, Iron Chicken, Gold Chicken, and Iridium Duck

[b]Getting Your First Egg[/b]
Elemental eggs can be found in the following ways:
[list]
[*]Regular, Frozen, Magma, and Omni Geodes have a small chance to drop Copper, Iron, Gold, and Iridium Eggs respectively
[*]The Dwarf sells one Copper, Iron, or Gold egg per day
[*]The Desert Trader will exchange a Prismatic Shard for a single Iridium egg
[/list][b]The Egg Cracker[/b]
Once you have more eggs than you need for hatching, craft an Egg Cracker to convert them into ore. The recipe is available from the start and requires copper bars, iron bars, and wood to craft.
Regular eggs produce 1-4 ore and large eggs produce 3-7 ore.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
[*]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher if you haven't already
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI

[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with most other mods. If you find any conflicts please let us know in the comments!
If you have suggestions for new animals, balance feedback, or any issues please leave a comment. Thanks for downloading!
